label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Si desgarrando es desgarrado, lo traerá testigo; el desgarrado no pagará.
spanish: Si ciertamente es desgarrado, lo traerá como testigo; por el desgarrado no pagará.
grammarChanges: Added 'como' before testigo so the 3ms suffix object (lo) stays what is brought, and testigo stays its predicate complement rather than reading as the subject of traerá.
Added 'por' before el desgarrado so the fronted feminine noun stays the object of pagará; the unstated 3ms subject of the piel verb is unchanged.

Replaced the gerund 'desgarrando' (readable as a separate manner clause) with 'ciertamente' + 'es desgarrado', rendering the qal infinitive absolute and niphal imperfect as one emphatic tearing instead of two events.
